title: Host consent record
description: What THIS operator, on THIS machine, permitted — and nothing else. ⚠️ IT IS IGNORED RATHER THAN COMMITTED, AND THAT IS THE WHOLE DESIGN. A committed consent record would mean cloning a repository handed you somebody else's permission to use your machine's credentials, and nobody would ever see the prompt again (section 3.3). ⚠️ THREE PERMISSIONS, RECORDED SEPARATELY, BECAUSE THEY ARE THREE DIFFERENT QUESTIONS: may Kiln LOOK at what is configured here; may it USE a named provider and model, which authorises ongoing billable work; may it validate and use an optional external service. Detection is not consent and one grant is not another. ⚠️ NO CREDENTIAL, NO FINGERPRINT, NO VARIABLE VALUE — the record says what was permitted, never what was found.

inspection.description: Permission to read this host's Pi authentication store, custom-model registry, and the PRESENCE of credential environment variables. ⚠️ Declining is a recorded decision, not an absent one: `granted: false` means the operator said no and setup stays honestly partial, which is different from nobody having been asked. ⚠️ THE `allOf` + `unevaluatedProperties` SHAPE IS NOT DECORATION — a bare `$ref` here accepted any extra field, because `unevaluatedProperties` has nothing to attach to and the referenced `grant` cannot forbid what its own users legitimately add. A credential field passed validation until a test asked it to fail.

modelUse.description: Permission to USE the recorded provider and model on this host, which authorises ongoing potentially billable work. ⚠️ SEPARATE FROM INSPECTION BECAUSE FINDING A USABLE MODEL IS NOT PERMISSION TO SPEND ON IT.

provider.description: The provider this grant was given for. ⚠️ RECORDED SO THE GRANT CAN EXPIRE HONESTLY: a project that switches provider has not been granted anything about the new one, and the prompt must reopen.

model.description: The exact model the grant was given for, for the same reason.

research.description: Permission to validate and use the optional research service on this host. ⚠️ THE COMMITTED CHOICE IN `.pi/kiln.json` DOES NOT IMPLY THIS ONE. A clone carries the project's intent to use Tavily; it does not carry anyone's permission to spend this machine's Tavily credits (section 6.5).

provider.description: Recorded so that changing the research provider invalidates the grant rather than silently transferring it.

granted.description: ⚠️ A BOOLEAN AND NOT AN ABSENCE. `false` is a decision the operator made and it must survive a rerun; treating 'no' as 'not yet asked' is how a declined prompt becomes a prompt that asks again every launch until someone clicks through it.

decidedAt.description: When the operator decided. ⚠️ HERE THE TIMESTAMP IS THE CONTENT, not noise: a consent record without a time is a claim that someone agreed, with nothing saying when, and consent that cannot be dated cannot be audited or expired.
